new-york.hist: Dutch settlers founded New Amsterdam at the tip of Manhattan in the 1620s; the English took it in 1664 and renamed it New York. Times Square got its name in 1904, when The New York Times moved its offices there, and it has never really gone dark since.
new-york.sol: New York is a home port for Solana. In May 2025 the Solana Foundation held Accelerate there, a week of conferences that brought together more than 3,000 builders, executives and policymakers [1], and the Foundation keeps its largest office in the city's Lower East Side [2].
src: Accelerate 2025 recap: 3,000+ builders, executives and policymakers in New York City
Ship or Die at Accelerate 2025 · Solana Compass
Summary of the opening talk: the Foundation's largest headquarters is in New York's Lower East Side

paris.hist: Paris began as Lutetia, a Roman town on an island in the Seine, named after the Celtic Parisii who lived there first. The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's Fair and was meant to be temporary; the city kept it.
paris.sol: Superteam France, the local Solana community, opened The Bakery, a 300-square-metre co-working space in the heart of Paris, at its first birthday [1], and in June 2025 it ran a nine-day Solana Startup Village just outside the city [2].
src: Superteam France · The Bakery Grand Opening
Superteam France turns one and opens a 300 m² co-working space in Paris
June 10–18, 2025, Parmain, 30 minutes from Paris, with daily shuttles from Opéra
wish: Light does not need to shout.

tokyo.hist: Tokyo was once Edo, a small castle town that became the seat of the Tokugawa shoguns in 1603 and one of the largest cities in the world. It was renamed Tokyo, the eastern capital, in 1868. At Shibuya Crossing thousands of people cross at once, and somehow nobody bumps.
tokyo.sol: Superteam Japan launched in May 2024 [1]. It organises SuperTokyo, the largest Solana conference in Japan [2]; the 2025 main conference in Shibuya listed Jupiter among its partners and more than a thousand people attended [3].
src: SuperTokyo 2025, the largest Solana conference in Japan, organised by Superteam Japan
Partners include Jupiter, Circle, Pyth, Metaplex and SBI VC Trade; 1,000+ attended

london.hist: The Romans founded Londinium on the Thames almost two thousand years ago. Big Ben is the name of the great bell, not the tower: since 2012 the tower has been called the Elizabeth Tower.
london.sol: Solana Breakpoint 2026, the network's main yearly conference, took place at Olympia London on November 15–17, 2026, the first time it came to the UK [1]. The local community, Superteam UK, began in June 2023 [2].
src: The Token Supercycle Is Here: Breakpoint 2026 in London · solana.com
Breakpoint 2026 at Olympia London, November 15–17, the first time in the UK
London-based; according to its 2023 recap, Superteam UK began in June 2023
wish: Trust is built one promise at a time.

rome.hist: Legend says Rome was founded in 753 BC by Romulus. The Colosseum opened in AD 80 under the emperor Titus and could hold tens of thousands of people; its arches have watched almost two thousand years go by.
rome.sol: In Italy, the Superteam World Tour stopped in Milan, bringing local builders together around Solana, with an Italian aperitivo [1]. We did not find a Solana event in Rome itself yet.
src: The Milan stop of the Superteam World Tour
wish: Hold the lesson, drop the weight.

cairo.hist: Cairo was founded in AD 969 by the Fatimid dynasty, beside the Nile. Across the river at Giza, the Great Pyramid was built for the pharaoh Khufu about 4,500 years ago, and the Sphinx still keeps watch.
cairo.sol: Students in Cairo joined the Dev3pack hackathon in person: a Cairo hub organised with Arabs in Blockchain, for a global Web3 and AI student hackathon co-hosted by Dev3pack, Solana, Vercel and ElevenLabs [1].
src: An in-person Cairo hub with Arabs in Blockchain for a hackathon co-hosted by Dev3pack, Solana, Vercel and ElevenLabs

sydney.hist: Sydney Harbour is the land of the Gadigal people; the British First Fleet arrived at Sydney Cove in 1788. The Opera House opened in 1973 and became a World Heritage site in 2007, its sails catching every sunset.
sydney.sol: Superteam Australia launched in Sydney with a rooftop event at Circular Quay, the start of its Outback Frontier tour [1], and with AUDC it started SOLAUDD, a grant programme for apps built on the Australian-dollar stablecoin AUDD on Solana [2].
src: Sydney Launch · Superteam Australia: The Outback Frontier
Rooftop launch event at Circular Quay, Sydney
A Solana grant developer programme for apps powered by AUDD

rio-de-janeiro.hist: The Portuguese founded Rio de Janeiro in 1565, between the mountains and the sea, and it was Brazil's capital until 1960. Christ the Redeemer, 30 metres tall, has opened his arms over the city since 1931.
rio-de-janeiro.sol: Brazil is one of Solana's focus countries: the Solana Foundation officially launched Superteam Brasil on January 1, 2024, with a summer campaign across the country [1].
src: Solana Foundation announces expansion to Brazil · Blocktrends
Superteam Brasil officially launched on January 1, 2024

new-delhi.hist: New Delhi was inaugurated in 1931 as the capital of British India and stayed the capital after independence. India Gate, completed the same year, is a memorial to soldiers of the First World War.
new-delhi.sol: Superteam India brings Solana builders together across the country; in New Delhi it hosts The Founders Pitch, a small gathering of early-stage founders [1], and it ran Solana Campus Connect for students at IIIT Delhi [2].
src: A curated gathering of early-stage founders in New Delhi, by Superteam
Solana x Superteam meetup for IIIT Delhi students, August 22, 2023

toronto.hist: Toronto was incorporated as a city in 1834, after decades as the town of York. The CN Tower, finished in 1976, rises 553 metres over Lake Ontario.
toronto.sol: Superteam Canada builds the Solana community from Toronto: it runs a co-working VibeStation every Friday [1] and organised Solana Summit Canada, a two-day conference in the city [2].
src: Co-working for web3 builders every Friday in Toronto
A two-day Solana conference in Toronto, September 23 and 24

reykjavik.hist: According to the sagas, Ingólfur Arnarson settled Reykjavík around 874, naming it the smoky bay after the steam of its hot springs. Hallgrímskirkja, finished in 1986, looks like basalt columns turned to stone, and on clear winter nights the northern lights dance above it.
reykjavik.sol: We searched and did not find a public Solana community event in Reykjavík. That says nothing against the city: Solana is open, and anyone in Iceland can use it, build on it or start the first meetup.

stockholm.hist: Stockholm is first mentioned in 1252, built on islands where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea. Gamla stan, the old town, still keeps its narrow medieval lanes and colourful houses.
stockholm.sol: We did not find a public Solana community event in Stockholm in our search. If you build on Solana in Sweden, the Wen Almanac would be glad to record it with a source.

helsinki.hist: King Gustav I of Sweden founded Helsinki in 1550; it became the capital of the Grand Duchy of Finland in 1812. The white Helsinki Cathedral, finished in 1852, stands above the Senate Square steps.
helsinki.sol: We did not find a public Solana community event in Helsinki in our search. Solana works the same from every country; the first local story is still waiting to be written.
wish: Today is a fresh block. gm.

amsterdam.hist: Amsterdam grew from a dam on the river Amstel and received city rights around 1300. Its 17th-century ring of canals became a World Heritage site in 2010.
amsterdam.sol: Breakpoint 2023 took place in Amsterdam from October 30 to November 3, bringing together more than 3,000 developers, investors, traders and artists; tickets could be paid in USDC and vending machines took Solana Pay [1]. Superteam NL is the local Solana hub [2].
src: Amsterdam, October 30 – November 3, 2023, 3,000+ attendees, Solana Pay vending machines
Solana Build Station: Amsterdam · Superteam NL
Superteam NL, the official Solana hub in the Netherlands

berlin.hist: Berlin is first documented in 1237. The Brandenburg Gate was built between 1788 and 1791; in 1989, when the Wall fell, it became the symbol of a city made whole again.
berlin.sol: Superteam Germany hosted Solana Summit Germany in Berlin, with about 1,860 people registered as attending [1], and Berlin has also hosted a Solana Hacker House [2].
src: A Solana Hacker House at Motorwerk, Berlin

zermatt.hist: Zermatt is a car-free village at the foot of the Matterhorn, 4,478 metres high. Edward Whymper's team made the first ascent in 1865, and the peak has drawn climbers and dreamers ever since.
zermatt.sol: Switzerland is where the Solana Foundation lives: it is a non-profit based in Zug [1]. The Superteam World Tour also made a Switzerland edition [2].
src: A non-profit foundation based in Zug, Switzerland
Solana Superteam World Tour · Switzerland Edition
The Switzerland stop of the Superteam World Tour
wish: The top is still there tomorrow.

ouro-preto.hist: Ouro Preto, once Vila Rica, was founded in 1711 during Brazil's gold rush. Its baroque churches, many carved by the sculptor Aleijadinho, made it a World Heritage site in 1980.
ouro-preto.sol: In Brazil, Superteam Brasil runs programmes at Solana House São Paulo, described as the biggest Solana hub in the country [1].
src: Solana House São Paulo, the biggest Solana hub in Brazil

galapagos.hist: The Galápagos Islands rise from the Pacific about 1,000 kilometres off Ecuador. Charles Darwin visited in 1835, and in 1978 the islands were among the very first World Heritage sites. The sea lions do not mind visitors.
galapagos.sol: We did not find a public Solana community event in Ecuador in our search. The chain is the same here as everywhere: open, fast and free to read.

machu-picchu.hist: Machu Picchu was built around 1450 for the Inca emperor Pachacuti, high in the Andes at about 2,430 metres. The world outside Peru learned of it in 1911, and it became a World Heritage site in 1983.
machu-picchu.sol: In Peru, the Lima community Dev3pack Peru organises Solana Builders Meetups [1] and hosted a Lima hub of the Dev3pack hackathon [2].
src: An in-person meetup organised by Dev3pack Peru
The Lima hub of the Dev3pack hackathon
